name: Push-ups
description: Keep your body in a straight line, elbows at about 45 degrees to your torso. Lower on inhale, push up on exhale.

name: Standing Dumbbell Curl
description: Stand tall, keep your elbows pinned to your sides. Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders without swinging or using momentum.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lie on the bench with feet flat on the floor. Lower the bar to your chest and press up, stopping just short of locking out the elbows.

name: Close-Grip Push-ups
description: Place your hands close together so your thumbs and index fingers form a triangle. Lower your chest toward your hands.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
description: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip, palms facing each other. Curl them to your shoulders without rotating your wrists.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
description: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead. Bend only at the elbows to lower it behind your head, then press back up.

name: Close-Grip Pull-ups
description: Grab the bar with a shoulder-width or narrower grip. Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, without swinging.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Stand tall, elbows pinned to your sides. Curl the bar to your shoulders using only your biceps, without leaning back.

name: Pike Push-ups
description: Form an inverted V with your body, hips high. Bend your arms and lower the top of your head toward the floor, then press back up.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
description: Hold the kettlebell at your shoulder, palm facing you. Press it overhead until your arm is straight, then lower it back smoothly.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back as if into a chair, keeping your back straight and knees tracking over your toes.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: Rest the barbell on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor or lower, knees tracking over toes.

name: Walking Lunges
description: Take a long step forward and lower until both knees bend to 90 degrees. Push off the front foot and bring the back leg forward.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold the kettlebell with both hands at chest level. Squat down, pushing your knees out, and keep your back straight.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells in front of your thighs. Hinge at the hips with a straight back, sliding the weights down your legs, knees slightly bent.

name: Jump Squats
description: Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then explode upward. Land softly on slightly bent knees.

name: Step-ups
description: Place one foot on the bench and drive through it to stand up. Lower down smoothly and switch legs.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rest the top of your back foot on the bench, front foot forward. Squat on the front leg until the thigh is parallel to the floor.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Stand tall and rise onto your toes, pausing for a second at the top. Hold dumbbells for extra resistance.

name: Sumo Squat with Kettlebell
description: Stand with feet wide and toes pointed out. Hold the kettlebell with both hands and squat between your knees, keeping your back straight.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-ups
description: Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Pull your chest to the bar, driving your elbows down and back.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: Hinge forward about 45–60 degrees with a straight back. Pull the bar toward your lower abs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Brace one knee and hand on a bench, back parallel to the floor. Pull the dumbbell to your hip, driving your elbow up.

name: Back Extension on Bench
description: Lie face-down on the bench with hips at the edge. Lift your torso with a straight back until your body forms a line with your legs.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders. Drive your hips powerfully to swing the kettlebell to chest height, using your back and glutes, not your arms.

name: Chin-ups
description: Grab the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing you, shoulder-width apart. Pull up smoothly, feeling your lats working.

name: Good Mornings
description: Rest the barbell on your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart. Hinge at the hips with a straight back and slightly bent knees, then return to standing.

name: Superman
description: Lie face-down with arms extended forward. Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor at the same time, hold for 1–2 seconds, then lower.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest. With arms slightly bent, lower it behind your head and return to start.

name: Renegade Row
description: Get into a plank position with hands on dumbbells. Row one dumbbell to your hip while keeping your torso stable, then switch sides.

name: Burpees
description: From standing, squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump back into a plank, do a push-up, return to squat, then jump up. A full-body compound movement.
